title: Service Connect Dealer Opt-Out
queue: Brand Engagement Center privacy / connected services
location: At home, receiving repeated dealer calls and texts
coverage: Service Connect dealer contact is opt-in; can be stopped in app or by BEC

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Toyota Brand Engagement, this is Ava. How can I help?

segments.speaker: Patient
segments.text: The dealer keeps calling me because of a Service Connect alert. I never asked for that. I want it stopped.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: Dealer contact from Service Connect is opt-in. I can help you turn off dealer notifications in the Toyota app privacy settings, or I can take the request here.

segments.speaker: Patient
segments.text: I also do not want Toyota tracking my location. Please opt me out today.

segments.speaker: Agent
segments.text: I will process the dealer opt-out and explain what Safety Connect, Service Connect, and Remote Connect collect. Law-enforcement location requests still follow legal process.

segments.speaker: Patient
segments.text: Thank you. Reply STOP did not work on the texts, so I called.
